waitingUser.behavior: End current active decision cycle, wait for new user trigger.

waitingExternal.behavior: Wait via Schedule/TaskRuntime, no busy poll.
waitingExternal.existingMechanism: Schedule tool等待外部条件满足

pendingTask.behavior: Do not create duplicate Task. Wait for B30 Observation to surface task completion.

pendingWorkflow.behavior: Do not create duplicate Workflow. Wait for B30 Observation.

awaitingApproval.behavior: Do not start new Decision Cycle. Wait for approve/deny/cancel/timeout.
